## 2026-11-22 14:52 · claude-macbook · mc-toonshader-mac

Litematica 0.29.1 / MaLiLib 0.30.2 (26.3) + Iris 1.11.7: both IrisCompat.registerPipelines() run from the RenderPipelines <clinit> mixin before IrisCompat.register() sets isIrisLoaded, so assignPipeline is skipped -> Iris "Missing program litematica:pipeline/legacy/translucent" etc.; ghost blocks drawn with Iris-extended vertex data via vanilla pipeline = stretched dark garbage, overlays invisible. Fix: ~/dev/masa-iris-bridge (javac build.sh, test passes) re-calls register()+registerPipelines() at CLIENT_STARTED; jar installed in mods. Gotcha: running tests with MC jar on classpath from the profile cwd makes log4j write/roll profile logs/latest.log (build.sh now cds into build/). Gamma Utils: Iris screenBrightness = options.gamma (15.0 at 1500%); Toon mac pack v3 adds GAMMA_LIFT = clamp((sb-1)/4,0,1)*0.8 as light floor in lighting/gear/water.

## 2026-11-22 10:01 · claude-macbook · mc-toonshader-mac

ToonShader v1.4.2 fails on Apple M2 (GL 4.1): shaders.properties declares image.* (Colored Toon Light) gated only on IS_IRIS+COLORED_LIGHT, so Iris 1.11.7 GlImage.clear -> glClearTexImage (GL4.4) null fn ptr -> NPE in IrisRenderingPipeline:259. Also ProgramBuilder.beginCompute throws on any .csh when !supportsCompute, so option toggles can't fix it. Iris defines IRIS_FEATURE_<flag> (only if isUsable) BEFORE preprocessing shaders.properties, so #ifdef IRIS_FEATURE_CUSTOM_IMAGES works there. Built shaderpacks/ToonShader_v1.4.2_mac.zip: images gated on IRIS_FEATURE_CUSTOM_IMAGES+COMPUTE_SHADERS, 3 composite.csh removed; original untouched; owner options copied to _mac.zip.txt.
